name: Outlook live sync
description: Incremental Outlook sync: list messages received after last_sync_at, upsert rows, advance checkpoint. Run per principal on partner cron.

steps.name: Build incremental filter

for_each_body_steps.name: Map conversation and message rows
for_each_body_steps.script:
local m = steps.get_message.result.message
return {
  conversation_row = {
    external_id = run.external_id,
    conversation_id = m.conversation_id,
    subject = m.subject,
    preview = m.body_preview,
    participants = { m.from },
    message_count = 1,
    last_message_at = m.received_date_time,
    is_read = m.is_read,
    synced_at = input.synced_at,
    source = "live",
  },
  message_row = {
    external_id = run.external_id,
    message_id = m.id,
    conversation_id = m.conversation_id,
    subject = m.subject,
    from_email = m.from,
    to_email = m.to,
    cc_email = m.cc,
    body_preview = m.body_preview,
    has_attachments = m.has_attachments,
    is_read = m.is_read,
    is_draft = m.is_draft,
    parent_folder_id = m.parent_folder_id,
    received_at = m.received_date_time,
    is_deleted = false,
    synced_at = input.synced_at,
    source = "live",
  },
}

steps.name: Advance sync checkpoint
steps.script:
local row = steps.build_filter.result.row or {}
return {
  external_id = run.external_id,
  connection_id = row.connection_id or input.connection_id or "",
  mailbox_email = row.mailbox_email,
  display_name = row.display_name,
  inbox_folder_id = row.inbox_folder_id,
  delta_link = row.delta_link,
  backfill_status = row.backfill_status or "complete",
  backfill_page_token = row.backfill_page_token,
  backfill_after = row.backfill_after,
  last_sync_at = input.synced_at,
  poll_interval_seconds = row.poll_interval_seconds or 120,
}
